title: Structure & Bridge Monitoring and Analysis
seoDescription: imc measurement technology for civil engineering: long-term monitoring of bridges and structures, oscillation measurement, remote monitoring with imc LINK.

props.title: Structure & Bridge Monitoring and Analysis
paragraphs: Measurement systems keep bridges and other structures safe through inspection and monitoring over long periods. Vibration and oscillation caused by environmental influences and traffic reveal how a structure behaves.
imc measurement technology covers short-term and long-term measurements, with remote monitoring and automatic data transfer.

items.title: Oscillation measurement
items.text: Immediate and long-term measurement of oscillations and vibrations.

items.title: Close to the sensor
items.text: Decentralised modular technology measures near the sensor for higher signal quality.

items.title: Remote monitoring
items.text: Automatic data transfer and remote monitoring with imc LINK.

items.title: Analysis and visualisation
items.text: Comprehensive analysis and visualisation of the captured data with imc FAMOS.

items.title: Building physics
items.text: Thermal measurement of room climate, sound and noise measurement, and measurement of energy use in buildings.
